definitions.full: H8613. Tophteh תָּפְתֶּה proper name, of a location (si vera lectio) id.; — as a place of burning, in figure of ׳י s judgement on Assyria Isa 30:33 (Klo Che Buhl Marti and others תֹּפֶת , joining ה to following as interrogative). תָּקְהַת Qr, תוקהת Kt, see תִּקְוָה . I, II, III. תִּקְוָה see [I. קוה ]. תְּקוּמָה see קוּם . [ תְּקוֺמֵם ], מֶיךָ -. [ תְּקוּפָה ] see קוף .
